scope: Decode the common DWG modeler wireframe-presence bit following the bounded AC1015/AC1018 SAT-v1 block sequence. The implementation records presence only and does not decode wireframe records, transforms, or 3D semantics.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: After modeler payload framing, the common layout carries a one-bit Wireframe data present field; true is followed by optional wireframe and silhouette data.

independentComparison.result: All 48 3DSOLID rows report wireframe_data_present=0; libdxfrw reports m_hasWireframe=false for each selected source handle.

implementation.behavior: After an exactly terminated SAT-v1 payload, read one bounded bit at the body cursor and publish its value to DRW_ModelerGeometry::m_hasWireframe. If the SAT-v1 carrier is not exactly framed, no wireframe-presence value is inferred. Wireframe body data remains unparsed.
implementation.regression: The existing hash-bound per-handle physical selector compares m_hasWireframe against the LibreDWG result while preserving its SAT payload, unit-header, ASCII/Binary readback, refusal, and same-adapter retry checks.

validation.result: 48/48 source handles passed; both ASCII and Binary projection/readback succeeded for every handle and the wireframe-presence values agreed with LibreDWG.
validation.fixturePolicy: The external DWG and LibreDWG JSON remain in /private/tmp; no fixture was added to Git.

limitations: This qualifies one common presence bit for one unauthenticated AC1018 producer sample, not wireframe payload semantics or producer breadth.
When the bit is true, point, isoline, wire, silhouette, viewport and transform fields are still opaque and are not surfaced as typed data.
No AC1015, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 or AC1032 wireframe profile is qualified by this result.
This does not establish ACIS source placement, independent geometry equivalence, native consumer acceptance, whole-file output, or format support.
